No calls, globals, relocations, stack writes, concurrency, MMIO, exceptions or faulting/null objects. Other flags and volatile registers are excluded by this high-level function boundary; a future binary ABI bridge must separately preserve any caller-dependent register relation. This arena and offset are an explicit fixture domain, not a recovered complete class layout.
